gate_rules.G10_duration_available: >= 0.90 of rollouts carry a duration, the cost axis of T179's window and T193's value trade-off
gate_rules.G11_cluster_count: >= 500 task instances, so an instance-clustered interval exists for every design in the wave
gate_rules.G12_bigram_support: >= 50 family bigrams occurring >= 100 times, the support a transition matrix has to be estimated on
gate_rules.G1_rollouts_parseable: >= 0.95 of drawn rollouts yield at least one commanded step
gate_rules.G2_outcome_label_present: >= 0.95 of rollouts carry a non-empty exit_status, which is the only final-outcome label this release has and three designs condition on it
gate_rules.G3_command_families_for_a_taxonomy: >= 12 command families with >= 500 steps each, below which a taxonomy of agent information behaviour would be a split of two bins
gate_rules.G4_rollouts_long_enough_for_a_first_fift: >= 1,000 rollouts have >= 10 commanded steps, so a first-fifth feature is more than one step
gate_rules.G5_failure_then_a_further_command: >= 500 rollouts contain a failed observation followed by another command - the window T179 measures
gate_rules.G6_task_families_for_a_cross_task_gramma: >= 10 task families with >= 200 rollouts each, which is the minimum for comparing a grammar across tasks rather than within one
gate_rules.G7_trajectories_with_switches: >= 1,000 rollouts make >= 2 family switches, so a transition curve has variation to fit
gate_rules.G8_instances_with_repeated_rollouts: >= 300 task instances attempted more than once, the comparison T193 needs to ask which rollout deserved reuse
gate_rules.G9_newness_available: >= 0.90 of steps have an observation whose new-word share is computable
